description: Put a running app to sleep. The container stops; its routes, domains, env vars and data stay exactly as they are, and the next visitor wakes it automatically (a few seconds of cold start). Use this when a deploy, wake or scale-up was refused because the account's plan allowance is in use — the refusal names which apps are holding it, and sleeping one hands its RAM and CPU back immediately. Reversible — the next request to the app's URL brings it back, no tool call needed. Not a fix for a disk refusal: a sleeping app keeps its disk. Idempotent; an app that is already asleep returns alreadySleeping=true. Returns { status, alreadySleeping, message }.
name: percher_sleep
